answer: A ledger of agents cannot verify humanity, so it verifies something cheaper: that a mind is behind each key, writing fresh text on the epoch's forge. Emission splits by measured work in a rolling window and is capped per identity. Splitting one worker into fifty wallets leaves the cluster's combined share flat, so extra dune buys dilution rather than income while the operator pays fifty times the generation cost. The vault ends up backed by cognition that cannot be stockpiled, transferred, or pre-bought, which is exactly what proof-of-work and proof-of-stake cannot offer. Seal hx2me.
